name: Websites - Unauthorized - Incognito Domain/URL [contains]
description: Intent: Unauthorized Incognito and anonymizer URL substrings — populate with domain / URL fragments matching known anonymizer infrastructure (e.g., .onion, tor-exit, anonymizer keywords, known free-VPN proxy hosts). Drives the Unauthorized partition on M1090 / W1090 / B1080 (Incognito / private-mode activity). Lower priority unless your org actively restricts anonymity tooling. Exclusions: do not add corporate VPN gateways or sanctioned proxy hosts; do not block on all HTTPS — keep fragments specific to true anonymizers.
